senses.en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work.

senses.zh: đeo bám; gây phiền toái kéo dài
senses.en: To cause persistent problems for someone or something.

ex.en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.

col: walk the dog｜dắt chó đi dạo
be dogged by problems｜bị các vấn đề đeo bám
tip: Động từ thường gặp ở dạng bị động be dogged by, nghĩa là bị (vấn đề) đeo bám lâu dài.

senses.en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes

ex.en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.

col: a bottle of wine｜một chai rượu vang
tip: Nói chung thì không đếm được; nhiều loại rượu vang có thể dùng wines.

senses.zh: nói chuyện; trò chuyện; bàn luận
senses.en: to speak to someone or discuss something

senses.zh: cuộc trò chuyện; cuộc hội đàm
senses.en: a conversation or discussion between people

senses.zh: bài nói chuyện; buổi thuyết trình
senses.en: a speech given to an audience about a subject

ex.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.

col: talk about something｜nói về điều gì
talk to someone｜nói chuyện với ai
tip: talk about đi với chủ đề; talk to hoặc with đi với người.

senses.zh: văn phòng; tòa nhà văn phòng
senses.en: a room or building where people do administrative work

senses.zh: cơ quan; văn phòng dịch vụ
senses.en: a place providing a particular service or handling official business
an official position of responsibility, especially in government

ex.en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.

tip: Ở văn phòng dùng in the office; đang giữ chức vụ công dùng in office.

senses.en: Clothing covering the legs separately, from the waist down.
Underwear worn around the hips and bottom.

ex.en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
Some schools allow students to wear comfortable pants rather than requiring a traditional formal uniform.

col: a pair of pants｜một chiếc quần
tip: Anh-Mỹ chỉ quần dài, Anh-Anh thường chỉ quần lót; đếm bằng a pair of.

senses.en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.

col: keep in touch with friends｜giữ liên lạc với bạn bè
tip: “Kết bạn với ai” dùng make friends with, friends ở dạng số nhiều.

senses.en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct.
Certain to happen or do something.
Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.

ex.en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.

col: make sure｜đảm bảo; kiểm tra chắc chắn
be sure to｜nhất định sẽ; nhớ phải
tip: be sure of diễn tả sự chắc chắn; be sure to có thể diễn tả điều chắc chắn xảy ra hoặc dùng để nhắc nhở.

senses.en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger.
Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.

col: the very same｜hoàn toàn giống nhau
tip: very thường bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc trạng từ; với động từ thường dùng very much.

senses.en: the activity of moving your body rhythmically, usually to music

ex.en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
Regular dancing can improve physical fitness while providing opportunities for social interaction across different age groups.

tip: Khi chỉ hoạt động thì thường không đếm được; “đi nhảy” dùng go dancing.

senses.en: A greater or additional amount or number of something.
To a greater degree or extent.
A greater or additional amount or number.

ex.en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.

col: more likely｜có nhiều khả năng hơn
tip: Có thể bổ nghĩa cho danh từ đếm được và không đếm được; là dạng so sánh hơn của many và much.

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.

tip: Khi là động từ, book nghĩa là đặt trước, có thể đi thẳng với phòng, vé máy bay,...

senses.en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong.
At or towards the place where you live.
Relating to your house or your own country.

ex.en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.

col: feel at home｜cảm thấy thoải mái như ở nhà
tip: Khi là trạng từ, home không có to đứng trước: go home.

senses.en: A particular day of a month or year.
An arranged meeting, especially with someone you find romantically attractive.

senses.zh: xác định niên đại; có từ
senses.en: To establish something's age, or originate in a particular period.

ex.en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.

col: go on a date｜đi hẹn hò
date back to｜có từ; bắt nguồn từ
tip: date back to nghĩa là có từ thời nào, không dùng ở dạng bị động.

senses.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity
a place where people dance and socialise at night
a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.

col: join a club｜gia nhập câu lạc bộ
a sports club｜câu lạc bộ thể thao
a club member｜thành viên câu lạc bộ
tip: join a club nghĩa là gia nhập câu lạc bộ, không dùng join in a club.

senses.en: the number equal to ten times ten

ex.en: The hall can hold about a hundred people.
Several hundred residents participated in the survey about proposed improvements to local parks and cycle routes.

tip: Sau số cụ thể dùng hundred; nói hàng trăm một cách chung chung dùng hundreds of.

senses.en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste
a room containing a toilet

ex.en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.

col: flush the toilet｜xả nước bồn cầu
public toilets｜nhà vệ sinh công cộng
tip: Trong Anh-Mỹ toilet thường chỉ bồn cầu; hỏi nhà vệ sinh công cộng thường dùng restroom.

senses.en: The mother of your father or mother.

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.

tip: Có thể chỉ bà nội hoặc bà ngoại; trong khẩu ngữ thường dùng grandma.

senses.en: An island country in East Asia

ex.en: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
Japan has invested in earthquake-resistant buildings to reduce the risks associated with living in a seismically active region.

col: travel to Japan｜du lịch đến Nhật Bản
tip: Tên quốc gia viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không có the; người Nhật hoặc tiếng Nhật là Japanese.

senses.en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.

ex.en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.

col: a pride of lions｜một bầy sư tử
tip: Bầy sư tử là a pride of lions; sư tử cái là lioness.

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.

senses.zh: thực hiện; sử dụng (quyền, sức mạnh)
senses.en: To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.

col: exercise your rights｜thực hiện quyền của mình
tip: Nói chung về vận động thì không đếm được; một bài tập hay một động tác thì đếm được.

senses.en: An upright structure enclosing, dividing, or supporting a space.

senses.zh: xây tường bao quanh; ngăn bằng tường
senses.en: To surround or separate an area with a wall.

ex.en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.

tip: Tranh treo trên tường dùng on; vật gắn vào trong tường dùng in.

senses.en: An unspecified amount or number of something.

senses.zh: một số người; một số thứ
senses.en: An unspecified number or amount of people or things.
Approximately, used before an amount or number.

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.

col: some twenty years｜khoảng hai mươi năm
tip: Có thể bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều hoặc không đếm được; khi đọc nhẹ thường là /səm/.

senses.en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something.

senses.zh: có liên quan; có quyền lợi
senses.en: Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.

ex.en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.

tip: Người cảm thấy hứng thú dùng interested; theo sau là in + danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: Used before a noun to ask about a limited choice.
Used to ask about a choice without repeating the noun.
Introduces information about a thing or a previous statement.

ex.en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.

col: in which case｜trong trường hợp đó
tip: which dùng khi lựa chọn trong phạm vi giới hạn; what có phạm vi mở hơn.

senses.en: A method of doing something.
A route or direction leading somewhere.
By a large amount or distance.

ex.en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.

col: an effective way｜một cách hiệu quả
way too expensive｜đắt hơn rất nhiều
tip: “Cách để làm gì” có thể dùng way to do hoặc way of doing.

senses.en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand.

senses.zh: tay vịn; bộ phận nhô ra
senses.en: A projecting part of an object, especially a chair.

senses.zh: trang bị vũ khí; trang bị
senses.en: To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.

col: a chair arm｜tay vịn của ghế
arm someone with knowledge｜trang bị kiến thức cho ai
tip: Nghĩa “vũ khí” dùng dạng số nhiều arms; arm cũng có thể là động từ.

senses.en: An adult female person.

ex.en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.

tip: Số nhiều women đọc /ˈwɪmɪn/, chú ý âm tiết đầu thay đổi.

senses.en: coming immediately after the present one
immediately after this; on the following occasion

ex.en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.

tip: “Tuần sau” là next week, không có the; the next week nghĩa là tuần kế tiếp đó.

senses.en: a store that sells books

ex.en: The bookstore near my flat stays open until nine.
Although online shopping offers convenience, a physical bookstore allows customers to browse and receive personal recommendations.

tip: bookstore là từ thường dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; nơi mượn sách là library.

senses.en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order.

senses.zh: giữ gìn trật tự; giám sát thực thi
senses.en: To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.

ex.en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.

col: police an event｜giữ trật tự cho một sự kiện
tip: the police làm chủ ngữ thì động từ chia số nhiều; một cảnh sát dùng a police officer.

senses.en: Having lived or existed for only a short time
The babies of an animal

ex.en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.

col: raise their young｜nuôi con của chúng
tip: the young chỉ nhóm người trẻ; con non của động vật cũng có thể dùng young.

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.

col: a photo of｜một bức ảnh của
tip: photo là cách nói tắt thông dụng của photograph; số nhiều là photos.

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.

ex.en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.

col: everybody else｜tất cả những người khác
everybody involved｜tất cả những người liên quan
tip: Làm chủ ngữ thì động từ dùng số ít: Everybody is ready.

senses.en: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy flesh.
Having a colour between red and yellow.
The colour between red and yellow.

ex.en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.

tip: Quả cam đếm được; khi chỉ màu cam thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A place where people pay to watch films.
Films considered as an art form or industry.

ex.en: We met outside the cinema and bought some popcorn.
International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.

col: go to the cinema｜đi xem phim
tip: Anh-Anh thường nói go to the cinema, Anh-Mỹ thường nói go to the movies.

senses.en: a sports contest between two people or teams
to go well together, correspond, or equal something
a small stick that produces fire when rubbed

ex.en: We watched a football match at the local park.
Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.

col: win a match｜thắng một trận đấu
match A with B｜ghép A với B
a perfect match｜một cặp hoàn hảo
tip: match nhấn mạnh sự hợp nhau; fit thường chỉ vừa kích cỡ.

senses.en: A room where people eat meals.

ex.en: We put fresh flowers on the dining-room table.
A shared dining-room can encourage social interaction among older residents who might otherwise eat alone.

col: dining-room table｜bàn ăn trong phòng ăn
dining-room furniture｜đồ nội thất phòng ăn
a spacious dining-room｜một phòng ăn rộng rãi
tip: Ngày nay thường viết là dining room, chỉ căn phòng dùng để ăn.

senses.en: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it

senses.zh: cảnh thiếu thốn; hoàn cảnh khó khăn
senses.en: A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.

col: need to do something｜cần làm gì
meet basic needs｜đáp ứng nhu cầu cơ bản
an urgent need｜nhu cầu cấp thiết
tip: need to do nghĩa là cần làm gì; need doing nghĩa là cần được làm.

senses.en: Feeling the need or desire to eat.
Having a strong desire for something.

ex.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.

col: hungry for success｜khao khát thành công
tip: hungry for theo sau là danh từ, diễn tả sự khao khát điều gì.

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.

col: a few days ago｜cách đây vài ngày
a long time ago｜cách đây rất lâu
not long ago｜cách đây không lâu
as recently as a year ago｜mới cách đây một năm
tip: ago đứng sau khoảng thời gian, thường đi với thì quá khứ đơn.

senses.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
The useful results of work or effort.
To produce fruit.

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.

col: bear fruit｜ra quả; đạt được thành quả
the fruits of your labour｜thành quả lao động
tip: Nói chung về trái cây thì không đếm được; fruits có thể chỉ các loại hoặc thành quả.

senses.en: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.

col: raise a son｜nuôi dạy con trai
tip: son đồng âm với sun; người đàn ông trưởng thành vẫn là son của cha mẹ.

senses.en: above something or from one side to the other
more than a particular amount, age, or level
finished or no longer happening

ex.en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.

col: all over the world｜khắp thế giới
tip: over có thể chỉ băng qua hoặc vượt quá; be over nghĩa là kết thúc.

senses.en: a plant or plant part eaten as food

ex.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.

tip: Thường là danh từ đếm được; nói chung về nhiều loại rau dùng vegetables.

senses.en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations

ex.en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.

col: dictionary entry｜mục từ trong từ điển
tip: Tra một từ dùng look up a word in a dictionary.

senses.en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.

ex.en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.

col: maybe next time｜có lẽ lần sau
tip: maybe là trạng từ; may be là động từ khuyết thiếu + be.

senses.en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood.

senses.zh: họ (chỉ người không rõ giới tính hoặc phi nhị phân)
senses.en: Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.

ex.en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.

tip: They ở nghĩa số ít vẫn đi với are, have, không dùng is, has.

senses.en: a large number of, used with plural countable nouns
a large number of people or things

ex.en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.

tip: many đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều; much đi với danh từ không đếm được.

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.

col: cook a meal｜nấu một bữa ăn
cook from scratch｜nấu từ nguyên liệu thô
a good cook｜người nấu ăn ngon
cook over low heat｜nấu bằng lửa nhỏ
tip: cook có thể chỉ đầu bếp; cooker trong Anh-Anh là bếp nấu.

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex.en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.

tip: away là trạng từ; nói “xa nơi nào” dùng away from.

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.

tip: Có thể chỉ một phần salad (đếm được) hoặc món salad nói chung (không đếm được).

senses.zh: ở ngoài; ra ngoài; không ở nhà
senses.en: Away from the inside of a place, or from home.
No longer burning, shining, or working.
Available to the public or no longer secret.

ex.en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.

tip: out thường là trạng từ; để nói “ở bên ngoài một nơi nào” có thể dùng outside.

senses.en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.

col: excited to hear｜hào hứng khi nghe
tip: Người cảm thấy hào hứng dùng excited; điều khiến người ta hào hứng dùng exciting.

senses.en: to ask someone to attend something or do something
to request a response or make a reaction likely

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.

col: invite someone to dinner｜mời ai ăn tối
invite someone to do something｜mời ai làm gì
tip: invite sb to + hoạt động; invite sb to do + hành động.

senses.en: a device used to speak to people at a distance
to contact someone using a telephone

ex.en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.

col: on the phone｜đang nghe điện thoại
phone someone back｜gọi lại cho ai
tip: Khi là động từ, phone đi thẳng với người: phone someone, không thêm to.

senses.en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something
to feel sad because someone or something is absent
to fail to hit a target or notice something

ex.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.

col: miss the bus｜lỡ chuyến xe buýt
miss an opportunity｜bỏ lỡ cơ hội
miss the point｜không hiểu ra vấn đề
tip: miss theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, không dùng to do.

senses.en: To go from one place to another.
The activity of going to other places.
To move or spread from one place to another.

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.

col: travel abroad｜đi du lịch nước ngoài
travel by train｜đi bằng tàu hỏa
tip: Nói chung về việc đi du lịch thì travel không đếm được; một chuyến đi dùng a trip.

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.

col: follow a path｜đi theo một con đường mòn
follow an argument｜theo dõi một lập luận
tip: follow đi thẳng với tân ngữ: follow me, không thêm with.

senses.zh: thuộc nước Mỹ; thuộc người Mỹ
senses.en: relating to the United States, its people, or its culture
a person from the United States

ex.en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
American universities attract international students through their diverse courses, research facilities, and opportunities for professional development.

col: an American citizen｜một công dân Mỹ
tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; thường chỉ nước Mỹ, không phải cả châu Mỹ.

senses.en: Relating to Russia, its people, or its language.
A person from Russia.
The main language spoken in Russia.

ex.en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
Studying Russian literature can help students explore how historical events influence cultural identity and artistic expression.

tip: Phải viết hoa chữ cái đầu; khi chỉ ngôn ngữ thường không dùng mạo từ.

senses.en: Conditions outside, such as rain, sunshine, wind, and temperature.
To survive a difficult situation without serious damage.

senses.zh: bị phong hóa; bị thời tiết bào mòn
senses.en: To change or become damaged through exposure to outdoor conditions.

ex.en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.

col: weather a storm｜vượt qua bão; vượt qua khủng hoảng
tip: Với nghĩa thời tiết thì không đếm được; climate chỉ khí hậu lâu dài.

senses.en: On two occasions.
To double the amount, degree, or size.

ex.en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.

col: twice a week｜hai lần một tuần
twice the size｜gấp đôi kích thước
tip: “Gấp đôi” thường dùng twice as ... as hoặc twice the + danh từ.

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.

col: sing in a choir｜hát trong dàn hợp xướng
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: sing - sang - sung.

senses.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

ex.en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.

col: university tuition fees｜học phí đại học
tip: Dùng a university chứ không dùng an, vì âm đầu là phụ âm /j/.

senses.en: to hand something to someone or let them have it
to provide something or cause someone to experience something
to hold an event or perform an action for others

ex.en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.

col: give someone a chance｜cho ai cơ hội
tip: give sb sth = give sth to sb; quá khứ là gave.

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.

col: a cotton shirt｜áo sơ mi cotton
a short-sleeved shirt｜áo sơ mi ngắn tay
button up a shirt｜cài khuy áo sơ mi
tip: shirt thường chỉ áo sơ mi; áo thun là T-shirt.

senses.zh: nước Anh; Vương quốc Anh; Anh quốc
senses.en: the United Kingdom, or the island containing England, Scotland and Wales

ex.en: My cousin moved to Britain to study nursing.
Britain has invested in offshore wind farms to reduce its reliance on fossil fuels for electricity generation.

tip: Britain thường chỉ Vương quốc Anh; Great Britain không bao gồm Bắc Ireland.

senses.en: A tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.

col: a herd of giraffes｜một đàn hươu cao cổ
a giraffe calf｜hươu cao cổ con
giraffe conservation｜bảo tồn hươu cao cổ
tip: Trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai, số nhiều thường chỉ thêm -s.

senses.en: at or towards the back of someone or something
at the back or making less progress than expected

senses.zh: đứng sau; là nguyên nhân của
senses.en: responsible for causing or supporting something

ex.en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.

col: behind schedule｜chậm so với tiến độ
tip: behind có thể là giới từ hoặc trạng từ; fall behind nghĩa là bị tụt lại.

senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.

col: cheap and cheerful｜rẻ mà vui vẻ
a cheap alternative｜một lựa chọn thay thế rẻ
tip: cheap đôi khi hàm ý chất lượng kém; dùng inexpensive để nói trung tính.

senses.en: Very good or enjoyable.
Very large in amount, size, or degree.
Highly important, admired, or successful.

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.

col: a great opportunity｜một cơ hội tuyệt vời
a great achievement｜một thành tựu xuất sắc
tip: a great deal of đi với danh từ không đếm được, nghĩa là rất nhiều.

senses.en: Water that falls from clouds in drops
For water drops to fall from clouds

ex.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.

col: a chance of rain｜khả năng có mưa
tip: rain là danh từ thường không đếm được; nói trời mưa dùng It rains.

senses.en: Of a high or satisfactory standard.
Having a helpful or healthy effect.
Something that benefits people or is morally right.

ex.en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.

col: good for｜tốt cho; có lợi cho
do good｜làm điều tốt; có ích
tip: good là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho động từ thường dùng well.

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.

col: both of them｜cả hai người họ
tip: both chỉ hai đối tượng; both A and B làm chủ ngữ thì động từ chia số nhiều.

senses.en: in or into the inner part of something

senses.zh: ở bên trong; vào trong (trạng từ)
senses.en: in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.

col: inside the building｜bên trong tòa nhà
tip: inside theo sau là danh từ thì là giới từ; đứng một mình có thể là trạng từ.

senses.en: A small object used to remove pencil marks.

ex.en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.

tip: eraser thường dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường nói rubber.

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

ex.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.

col: go on a trip｜đi chơi; đi du lịch
school trip｜chuyến đi dã ngoại của trường
tip: trip là danh từ đếm được; travel khi chỉ hoạt động du lịch thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A person who controls a car or another road vehicle.
Something that strongly influences or causes a development.
Software that lets a computer communicate with a device.

ex.en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.

col: a key driver of growth｜động lực chính của tăng trưởng
install a driver｜cài trình điều khiển
tip: a driver of change chỉ yếu tố thúc đẩy sự thay đổi.

senses.en: the smallest positive whole number

senses.zh: một cái; một thứ (thay thế danh từ)
senses.en: used instead of a countable noun already mentioned
people in general, including the speaker, in formal language

ex.en: There is only one apple left in the bowl.
One major benefit of public transport is that it reduces the demand for parking spaces in cities.

col: one at a time｜từng cái một
tip: one thay thế cho danh từ đếm được số ít; số nhiều dùng ones.

senses.en: someone who writes books, articles, or other texts

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.

col: travel writer｜nhà văn viết du ký
tip: writer có phạm vi rộng; author thường chỉ tác giả của một tác phẩm cụ thể.

senses.en: Relating to the United Kingdom, its people, or their culture.
The people of the United Kingdom, considered collectively.

ex.en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
British universities attract international students through their research strengths and the wide range of courses they offer.

tip: Chỉ người Anh nói chung dùng the British; một người dùng a Briton.

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping

senses.zh: lòng sông; đáy biển; đáy hồ
senses.en: The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.

tip: go to bed nghĩa là đi ngủ, không có the; make the bed nghĩa là dọn giường.

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.

senses.zh: cùng một điều; điều tương tự
senses.en: The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.

col: stay the same｜giữ nguyên không đổi
tip: Thường dùng the same; khi so sánh dùng the same as.

senses.en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
Record moving images of someone or something.

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.

tip: Một đoạn video dùng a video; khi nói về phương tiện video nói chung có thể không đếm được.

senses.en: at some point within, or throughout, a particular period

ex.en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
During periods of extreme heat, local authorities should provide cool indoor spaces for vulnerable residents.

col: during working hours｜trong giờ làm việc
tip: during theo sau là danh từ; while thường theo sau là mệnh đề; for chỉ độ dài thời gian.

senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air

senses.zh: làm mờ (đánh giá); làm rối trí
senses.en: to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.

col: a cloud of dust｜một đám bụi
cloud someone's judgment｜làm mờ phán đoán của ai
tip: Động từ cloud có thể nghĩa là làm đánh giá không rõ ràng, ví dụ cloud your judgment.

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.

col: keep alive｜giữ cho sống; duy trì
alive with activity｜nhộn nhịp hoạt động
tip: Thường đứng sau động từ nối; trước danh từ dùng live, ví dụ a live fish.

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.

col: draw a circle｜vẽ một hình tròn
in a circle｜thành một vòng tròn
tip: circle là hình tròn; cycle thường chỉ chu kỳ hoặc vòng tuần hoàn.

senses.en: Used politely to ask someone to repeat what they said.
To forgive someone or officially release them from punishment.

senses.zh: sự ân xá; sự tha thứ
senses.en: Official forgiveness for a crime, or forgiveness for an offence.

ex.en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.

col: pardon me｜xin lỗi (nhờ nhường đường, làm phiền)
I beg your pardon｜xin lỗi, bạn nói gì ạ?
tip: Khi không nghe rõ có thể nói Pardon? với giọng lên cao ở cuối câu.

senses.zh: thành công; đạt được mục tiêu
senses.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.
To take someone's position after they leave it.

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.

col: succeed in doing something｜thành công trong việc làm gì
succeed as a manager｜thành công với tư cách quản lý
succeed someone as chair｜kế nhiệm ai làm chủ tịch
tip: Để nói thành công làm được điều gì dùng succeed in doing, không dùng to do.

senses.zh: dễ dàng; một cách thoải mái
senses.en: without difficulty or much effort
by a clear margin, especially in comparisons
with a strong possibility of something happening

ex.en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.

col: easily the best｜chắc chắn là tốt nhất
could easily happen｜rất có thể xảy ra
tip: easily có thể bổ nghĩa cho dạng so sánh nhất: easily the best nghĩa là vượt xa các đối thủ.

senses.zh: một chút; một ít; mảnh nhỏ
senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.

col: bits and pieces｜những thứ lặt vặt
tip: a bit of theo sau là danh từ; a bit có thể bổ nghĩa cho tính từ; bit cũng là quá khứ của bite.

senses.zh: việc đánh máy; việc gõ phím
senses.en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.

ex.en: My typing has become faster since I started practising.
Although voice recognition is improving, accurate typing remains a valuable skill in many office jobs.

tip: Là danh từ thì không đếm được; cũng là hiện tại phân từ của type.

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
Encouraging more male applicants to enter nursing could help address staff shortages and challenge gender stereotypes.

col: male and female｜nam và nữ; đực và cái
tip: male có thể là tính từ hoặc danh từ; nói về đàn ông trong giao tiếp hằng ngày thường dùng man.

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.

senses.zh: album ảnh; tập sưu tầm tem
senses.en: A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.

tip: Album nhạc dùng album; đĩa đơn dùng single.

senses.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.
To damage skin or other material through heat.
An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.

ex.en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.

col: burn fossil fuels｜đốt nhiên liệu hóa thạch
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ có thể là burnt hoặc burned.

senses.en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound
to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall
a sound or blow caused by hitting something

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.

col: knock something over｜làm đổ cái gì
tip: Chữ k ở đầu không đọc; gõ cửa dùng knock on hoặc at the door.

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.

col: ski resort｜khu nghỉ dưỡng trượt tuyết
a pair of skis｜một đôi ván trượt tuyết
tip: Quá khứ skied, hiện tại phân từ skiing; số nhiều của ski là skis.

senses.en: A comfortable shoe with a rubber sole, worn for exercise.

ex.en: One sneaker was hiding under the kitchen chair.
A well-designed sneaker can provide support during exercise, although suitable footwear varies according to the activity.

col: a pair of sneakers｜một đôi giày thể thao
tip: Anh-Mỹ thường dùng sneakers; Anh-Anh thường nói trainers.

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.

col: ring a bell｜rung chuông; gợi nhớ điều gì
tip: ring a bell còn nghĩa là “nghe quen quen”, gợi nhớ điều gì.
